On Feb 3, 2026, I booked a telehealth session via Grow Therapy with Kifle Jikamo, who is advertised as "Dr. Kifle Jikamo." I was
seeking specialized medication-assisted treatment (MAT/Suboxone) for Opioid Use Disorder, believing he was a medical physician.

During the encounter, Jikamo did not clarify he is a Nurse Practitioner. He conducted a 5-minute session, refused to provide
treatment, and terminated the call without a clinical assessment. Despite refusing care, he billed my Medi-Cal plan (L.A. Care) for a
full service, which was paid.

Using "Dr." in a clinical setting by a non-physician is a misdemeanor under California BPC § 2054. Under Palmer v. Bonta (Sept
2025), a federal court held that this use of "Dr." is inherently misleading to consumers, regardless of fine-print disclosures. I was
personally misled by this advertisement, resulting in delayed medical care and billing fraud.
